what: M5 stage 3: 13-blade wheels s07 (scan) and s09 (CAD mesh), built by meshsolid/impeller.py with the per-passage hub floor
basis: scan vertices -> solid in the scan's own coordinates (no alignment); scan-only stub/cap and balance cuts excluded; tessellation lin 0.01 mm
fixes: camber phase grid: empty/incoherent cells filled (7b825d0)
camber fitted away from the LE/TE end cells: a garbage TE row made the s09 blade sheets diverge (slab 5.0e6 mm3 -> 438 mm3) (e21ecc1)
slab side grids keep >= 30% of the median thickness in the extensions (7b825d0)
deviation: closest-point chunks sized by candidate count; exact subdivision of long-facet targets; impeller tessellation ang 0.5 rad (OOM on s09)

s07.bore: not in the scan: 14.275 assumed for the test build

rebuild_m5c.code: f1614ff (sheet LE round, conditional camber end slope, tip-fold fix)

s09.bore: scan 14.40; built 14.275 (stg1 design fit) for the test build
s09.note: CAD mesh: vertex statistics are weighted toward edges and fillets

le_round.outcome: s07 and s09: not modelled, LE kept sharp and flagged (report: impeller.le_round_flag + warning); stg1: r 0.65 mm post-trim
tried: both edges after the trim at r, 0.75r, 0.5r
both edges on the eye-plane-cut slab before the trim at r, 0.5r
one edge at a time with a ladder r .. 0.15r (56548e1; blade-only test on s07 and s09)
OCC fillet shapes Rational / QuasiAngular / Polynomial and loose SetParams (diagnostic)
le_round.diagnosis: OCC fillet walker fails (WalkingFailure / TwistedSurface / faulty end vertex) on the s07/s09 LE edges; success per edge flips with radius and results that build are often invalid. The s09 LE-round estimate is unstable (0.32 vs 1.05 mm between camber versions), so the LE may not be a flat-top-plus-round there. Smoothing the camber's LE continuation (38e274a) made one s09 edge fillet at 0.15 mm, not both.

sheet_round_b91c5ad.s07: blade-only test: rounded r 1.078 in the side sheets, valid, blade 442.6 vs 457.5 mm3 same-grid sharp
sheet_round_b91c5ad.s09: rejected: rounded blade volume above the same-grid sharp one; the s09 sheets fold near the tip extension (p-direction reversals at v 0.98-1.1), so volumes swing with the grid

stg1_check_pipe3.vs_m5_v8: slightly worse on blades (0.080/0.163 vs 0.075/0.149) and front face; still beats solid_body on all zones. f1614ff makes the camber end-slope smoothing conditional so stg1 keeps its old continuation.
